gen-mystery-quest-gf-cascadia-code: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest leaves open jaws on every curve, its compact ascenders perched above tall lowercase. Cascadia Code adds a wire-thin line and wide gaps beneath it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-julius-sans-one: Revalia leaves the lower curve of its lowercase g open, striding across widely spaced letters. Julius Sans One does the quiet work, keeping capitals and lowercase near one height with wide gaps between letters.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-montserrat-alternates: Expressive from the first glance, Warnes lets ink strokes taper out before touching, stretched and spacious. And Montserrat Alternates is strongest in its uniform stroke, round letters whose rims match the stems.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-cascadia-mono: Fun, retro, and pinned far apart like cut-out letters. Press Start 2P does the playful part, thinning slightly at its curves; Cascadia Mono does the steady part with a monoline skeleton.
gen-righteous-satoshi: Thin steel rod bent into letters: Righteous packs its bowls so they fill the whole line. And Satoshi, with its single stroke width and soaring x-height, lets the two sit together easily.
gen-righteous-gf-cascadia-code: Righteous bends thin steel rod into each letter, bowls filling the line. Cascadia Code adds a wire-like monoline skeleton that stays smooth around every bend, plus wide gaps between neighbors.
gen-righteous-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One reads wide and open, with big stretches of blank space between letters and open-ended curves. Righteous fills each line with bowls, thin steel rod bent into shape, so the two pull against each other.
gen-eater-gf-montserrat-alternates: Dark and aggressive, with short ascenders and wide gaps between letters, Eater swings robust downstrokes against slender turns. Montserrat Alternates runs smoothly, its round letters free of any tilted stress.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-lexend-mega: Autour One draws a clear channel into each round letter, with no hairline-to-stem shift at all. Lexend Mega looks drawn with one nib, its body height nearly matching capitals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-montserrat-altern: Metamorphous holds large sidebearings all around and a high-set midline, with a soft difference between its fat and slim strokes. Montserrat Alternates offers zero stroke contrast, which is its defining quality.
